title: X-Forwarded-Prefix is ignored by Quarkus REST
body:
### Describe the bug

I am trying create a response in an endpoint with a redirect to another path. 

When using `X-Forwarded-*` headers, quarkus uses `X-Forwarded-Port`, `X-Forwarded-Proto` and `X-Forwarded-Host` to construct a response URI but does not use `X-Forwarded-Prefix`. 

### Expected behavior

I expected `X-Forwarded-Prefix` to be a part of the Location URI in a redirect response. 

### Actual behavior

`X-Forwarded-Prefix` is not a part of the Location URI in a redirect response. 

### How to Reproduce?

Project to reproduce: https://github.com/froque/quarkus-x-forwarded-prefix-reproducer

Create an endpoint:
```java
@Path("/old-path")
public class RedirectResource {

	@Path("/location")
	@GET
	public Response redirectToNewPath1() {
		return Response
				.status(Response.Status.FOUND)
				.location(java.net.URI.create("/new-path"))
				.build();
	}
}
```

file `src/main/resources/application.properties`
```
quarkus.http.proxy.proxy-address-forwarding=true
quarkus.http.proxy.enable-forwarded-host=true
quarkus.http.proxy.allow-forwarded=true
quarkus.http.proxy.allow-x-forwarded=true
quarkus.http.proxy.enable-trusted-proxy-header=true
quarkus.http.proxy.enable-forwarded-prefix=true

quarkus.http.root-path=some-root-path
```

call endpoint with `X-Forwarded-*` headers
```shell
❯ curl -I \
  -H 'X-Forwarded-Port:81' \
  -H 'X-Forwarded-Proto:https' \
  -H 'X-Forwarded-Host:example.com' \
  -H 'X-Forwarded-Prefix:/some-forwarded-prefix' \
  http://localhost:8080/some-root-path/old-path/location
HTTP/1.1 302 Found
Location: https://example.com:81/some-root-path/new-path
```

Expected `https://example.com:81/some-forwarded-prefix/some-root-path/new-path`

### Output of `uname -a` or `ver`

Linux PM-FRoque 6.8.0-60-generic #63~22.04.1-Ubuntu SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Tue Apr 22 19:00:15 UTC 2 x86_64 x86_64 x86_64 GNU/Linux

This discussion seems to be related: https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/discussions/46313
